answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Signed beekeeping association membership with apiary inspection records flips the bet — an apiary inspected yearly by the association — and the anchor lands on the attacker instead. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the signal of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The trellis is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
